subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public bare-reset greeting contract should OpenClaw support across auto-reply and Gateway: ack-only, startup/model greeting, suppressible greeting, cheaper greeting model routing, or one typed policy that covers all of them?
rationale: Current shipped code and docs encode acknowledgement-only bare resets, while this issue and related reports ask for restore/suppress/model-routing behavior; choosing a config contract changes session semantics, model cost, and provider routing.

options.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
options.body: Define a single policy shape that covers acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Keep this broader issue open but let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45501 own only reset prompt wording, without solving cheaper model routing or suppression.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only As Product Direction
options.body: If maintainers want bare resets to stay cheap and non-model by design, close or narrow this issue and document `/new <message>` or a future explicit startup-turn command as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
recommendation.body: Define a single policy shape that covers acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement-only reset contract and has already reviewed this issue’s remaining product decision.
